lines.en: label day303:
scene yasufirstday1
: Umm...Good morning, Ayane.
lines.zh: : 呃……早上好，Ayane。

lines.en: : Would it be a bother if I sat here for today?
lines.zh: : 今天我坐这里会不会打扰你？

lines.en: : I was originally going to sit in the back of the classroom to make sure I was not in anyone’s way, but...there is a girl who looks rather...frightening back there.
lines.zh: : 我本来打算坐教室后排，免得挡着别人，不过……后面有个女孩看起来相当……吓人。

lines.en: : Oh, that’s just Yumi.
lines.zh: : 哦，那是 Yumi。

lines.en: : She's not really scary, but she’ll probably make fun of you for being rich or something. Either way, you can sit here.
lines.zh: : 她其实不吓人，不过大概会因为你是有钱人之类的嘲笑你。不管怎样，你坐这儿吧。

lines.en: : I see...I had no idea that simply being wealthy could actually prove disadvantageous in certain cases.
lines.zh: : 这样啊……我还真不知道，光是有钱在某些情况下也会变成劣势。

lines.en: : But I suppose I can just bring my bodyguard to[school] from now on to avoid any confrontations with her.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，以后我可以让保镖跟到[school]来，免得跟她正面冲突。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday2
: You...probably don’t have to go that far, you know. It’s not like she’s going to attack you or anything.
lines.zh: : 你……大概不用做到这个地步吧。她又不会真动手打你什么的。

lines.en: : Besides, wouldn’t you be able to hold your own anyway? I thought you started training in karate and stuff.
lines.zh: : 再说了，你自己不也能应付吗？我还以为你开始练空手道什么的了。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday3
: Oh...Yes, I suppose we never resolved that matter concerning your training facility.
lines.zh: : 哦……是啊，关于你那处训练场馆的事，我们好像一直没个了结。

lines.en: : Well...yeah. All this time, I kind of just figured it was a done deal. There’s no way my family can outspend yours when it really comes down to it.
lines.zh: : 嗯……是啊。这段时间我基本上就当这事已经定了。真要拼钱，我家是无论如何拼不过你家的。

lines.en: : Well, you need not concern yourself with that anymore.
lines.zh: : 那么，你今后不必再为这件事操心了。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: : You're not saying what I think you're saying, are you?
lines.zh: : 你该不会是在说我想的那个意思吧？

lines.en: : To...further clarify, I was able to convince my father that I was no longer interested in karate.
lines.zh: : 更……具体地说，我成功说服了我父亲，让他知道我对空手道已经没兴趣了。

lines.en: : I've decided to learn something else instead.
lines.zh: : 我决定改学别的东西。

lines.en: : But...why? You had to be pretty interested if things got to the point where you were literally about to hire a personal instructor and buy out a dojo.
lines.zh: : 可……为什么？都到了要请私人教练、买下整个道场的地步，你当时肯定是相当有兴趣吧。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday4
: Change of heart, I suppose?...
lines.zh: : 大概是改主意了吧？……

lines.en: : I didn’t realize how important that place was to you when I first arrived.
lines.zh: : 我刚来的时候，并不知道那地方对你有多重要。

lines.en: : It took a lot of convincing to have my father slow down the process, but...I do hope that you’ll be able to continue having fun there...as we will no longer be needing it.
lines.zh: : 我费了不少口舌才让我父亲把进度慢下来，不过……我真心希望你还能继续在那里过得开心……因为我们已经用不上它了。

lines.en: : You...really did all that for me?
lines.zh: : 你……真的为我做了这些？

lines.en: scene yasufirstday5
: There’s no need to make a fuss over it.
lines.zh: : 没必要大惊小怪的。

lines.en: : I’m sure it’s plenty apparent that I have a hard time picking up on certain things due to my upbringing, but I really do not want to be on poor terms with anyone. Especially you.
lines.zh: : 我的成长环境让我在有些事情上确实迟钝，这点想必已经很明显了，但我真的不想跟任何人关系不好。尤其是你。

lines.en: : So if choosing a different martial art is what I must do, then I will be sure to do it.
lines.zh: : 所以如果改学另一门武术是必须做的，那我一定会去做。

lines.en: : But, for now, I will continue to rely on a bodyguard to protect me from this “Yumi” character who appears to have a problem with girls that dress nicely and buy expensive things.
lines.zh: : 不过在那之前，我还是会继续靠保镖保护我，防着这个「Yumi」——她似乎对穿得好看、又买贵东西的女孩很有意见。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday6
: That was really nice of you, Touka...
lines.zh: : 你真是太好了，Touka……

lines.en: : As I said, please don’t make a fuss over it.
lines.zh: : 我说过了，别大惊小怪的。

lines.en: : If there is anyone in this[school] who I would benefit from creating a deep connection with, it is you.
lines.zh: : 如果说这所[school]里有谁值得我去深交，那就是你。

lines.en: : How unfortunate that our families must compete in the same market. A true Montagues and Capulets situation.
lines.zh: : 真是不幸，我们两家偏偏要在同一个市场上竞争。活脱脱一出蒙太古与凯普莱特。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday7
: Come to think of it, I’m not really sure what your family does.
lines.zh: : 说起来，我还真不太清楚你家是做什么的。

lines.en: : You’re really in the same market as mine? Because that’s like...a really weird market.
lines.zh: : 你真和我家在一个市场？因为那个……怎么说呢，挺奇怪的一个市场。

lines.en: : Oh, yes. It’s an incredibly strange market.
lines.zh: : 哦，没错。那是个极其奇怪的市场。

lines.en: : And while we’ve since expanded to many other markets like hospitality and food service, the one you find yourself in is where our initial fortune comes from.
lines.zh: : 虽然我们已经扩展到了酒店餐饮等许多其他市场，但你所处的那个，才是我们最初发家的行当。

lines.en: : You see, my grandfather is the original creator of bubble wrap. The poppable kind.
lines.zh: : 你看，我祖父是气泡纸的最初发明者。就是那种可以捏爆的。

lines.en: : Woah! Who would have thought Kumon-mi was home to both the family who created bubble wrap and the family who found fortune through innovating it?
lines.zh: : 哇！谁能想到 Kumon-mi 竟然同时住着发明气泡纸的家族，和靠改良它发家的家族呢？

lines.en: : I’m more surprised at just how profitable such a strange venture was for the two of our families.
lines.zh: : 我更惊讶的是，这么奇怪的一门生意居然让我们两家都赚得盆满钵满。

lines.en: : But, I suppose it’s best if we choose not to question our wealth and instead attempt to carry on our respective legacies.
lines.zh: : 不过我想，我们最好还是别去追问这些财富的来路，而是努力把各自的家业传承下去。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday8
: Yeah, I don’t think I’m really going to be involved in my family’s “legacy” after I get out of [high_school].
lines.zh: : 嗯，我觉得[high_school]毕业之后，我大概不会真的去接手家里的「家业」。

lines.en: : Oh dear. Have your product sales been falling?
lines.zh: : 哎呀。你们的产品销量下滑了吗？

lines.en: : Have consumers figured out how to pop your bubbles?
lines.zh: : 消费者们终于学会怎么捏爆你们的气泡了？

lines.en: : It’s not that. I just don’t really want to follow in my dad’s footsteps.
lines.zh: : 不是那个原因。我只是不太想走我爸的老路。

lines.en: : Money kind of turned him into a different person.
lines.zh: : 钱某种程度上把他变成了另一个人。

lines.en: : Well, is there something else you’d be interested in pursuing instead?
lines.zh: : 那么，有没有别的什么是你想追求的？

lines.en: : As I mentioned, the Tsukiokas have their hands in many different aspects of many different markets, and I would gladly put in a good word for you in any of them as I can already tell how kind you are.
lines.zh: : 正如我所说，Tsukioka 家在许多不同市场的许多不同领域都有涉足，而我已经看得出你有多善良，所以任何一处我都乐意替你美言几句。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday9
: Thanks, Touka. But I don’t really think something like that is what I want out of life.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，Touka。不过我觉得那不太是我想要的人生。

lines.en: : You don’t...want to succeed financially? Please explain your rationale as I’m quite unfamiliar with this peculiar thought process.
lines.zh: : 你……不想在财务上取得成功？请解释一下你的思路，我对这种奇特的思维方式实在是很不熟悉。

lines.en: : I think I’d just be happier if I settled down and...got to live as a housewife or something.
lines.zh: : 我觉得如果我安定下来……当个家庭主妇之类的，会幸福得多。

lines.en: : You know. Raising kids...making breakfast for Sensei every morning.
lines.zh: : 你知道的。养孩子……每天早上给 Sensei 做早餐。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday10
: For...who?
: I think I may have misheard you.
lines.zh: : 我想我大概是听错了。

lines.en: : For Sensei. Our teacher.
lines.zh: : 给 Sensei。我们的老师。

lines.en: : Didn't I say he was my future husband the first time you and I met?
lines.zh: : 我们第一次见面的时候，我不是说过他是我未来的丈夫吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but...after thinking more about it, I just figured you were joking.
lines.zh: : 说过，但是……我后来想了想，以为你是在开玩笑。

lines.en: : Nope. I’m in love with him and stuff and want to spend the rest of my life by his side.
lines.zh: : 没有。我就是爱上他了什么的，想这辈子都待在他身边。

lines.en: : That’s really the only way I’ll ever be happy.
lines.zh: : 那是我唯一会幸福的方式。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday11
: But...he’s in a completely different class!
lines.zh: : 可是……他的阶级完全不同啊！

lines.en: : What are you talking about? He’s literally right there.
lines.zh: : 你在说什么啊？他不就站在那儿吗。

lines.en: : Social class! You’d be giving up everything!
lines.zh: : 是社会阶级！你会放弃掉一切！

lines.en: : I had no idea it was even legal for people of our level to engage in relationships with those so far outside of it!
lines.zh: : 我都不知道我们这个层次的人，跟差这么远的人谈恋爱居然是合法的！

lines.en: : Also, why {i}him?{/i} If you are going to wed a commoner, at least wed one that is halfway decent as a human being!
lines.zh: : 还有，为什么是{i}他{/i}？如果你非要嫁个平民，至少也嫁个还算像样的人吧！

lines.en: : It doesn’t matter to me that I’d be “giving up everything” since I’d still be keeping the one thing in the world that brings me more happiness than any packaging wrap ever could.
lines.zh: : 对我来说「放弃一切」根本无所谓，因为我留住的是这世上唯一一个比任何包装纸都能带给我更多幸福的东西。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday12
: So...does this mean...the two of you are...
lines.zh: : 那么……这是不是意味着……你们两个已经……

lines.en: : Are what?
lines.zh: : 已经什么？

lines.en: scene yasufirstday13
: I can’t say it out loud! It would be completely shameful!
lines.zh: : 我说不出口！那简直太不知羞耻了！

lines.en: : But if you can’t say it out loud, how am I supposed to know what you’re talking about?
lines.zh: : 可你说不出口，我怎么知道你在说什么？

lines.en: : Do they not teach you context clues in this-
lines.zh: : 他们难道没教过你怎么看上下文线索吗——

lines.en: scene yasufirstday14
: Oh. Right.
lines.zh: : 哦。对。

lines.en: : They don’t teach you anything at all here.
lines.zh: : 这儿他们什么都没教过你。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday15
: Wow...
: So many desks...
lines.zh: : 好多桌子……

lines.en: : So many girls...
lines.zh: : 好多女孩……

lines.en: : So many voices...
lines.zh: : 好多声音……

lines.en: : Who is that character? She seems quite...odd.
lines.zh: : 那是个什么人物？她看起来相当……古怪。

lines.en: : No idea. I’ve never seen her before.
lines.zh: : 不知道。我从没见过她。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday16
: Maybe that’s your new roommate?
lines.zh: : 也许那就是你的新室友？

lines.en: : What? No...
lines.zh: : 什么？不是吧……

lines.en: : No, she’s likely just...lost!
lines.zh: : 不，她大概只是……迷路了！

lines.en: : Lost?
lines.zh: : 迷路？

lines.en: scene yasufirstday17
: I am many things...but lost is not one of them.
lines.zh: : 我是很多东西……但迷路不在其中。

lines.en: : Perhaps it is you that is lost?
lines.zh: : 也许迷路的是你？

lines.en: : Would you like to find out where to go?
lines.zh: : 你想知道该往哪儿走吗？

lines.en: : I can show you the way.
lines.zh: : 我可以为你指路。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday18
: Are...missionaries even allowed in this[school]?
lines.zh: : 传教士……也允许进这所[school]吗？

lines.en: : Like, not even the good kind of missionary either, if you know what I’m talking about.
lines.zh: : 而且甚至还不是那种「好」的传教士体位，你懂我意思吧。

lines.en: : Sana?
lines.zh: : Sana？

lines.en: scene yasufirstday19
: I know that you’re innocent and stuff, but that was a really good-
lines.zh: : 我知道你很纯洁什么的，不过刚才那个真的挺——

lines.en: scene yasufirstday20
: Woah. Hold up. What’s wrong?
lines.zh: : 哇。等等。怎么了？

lines.en: : Is everything okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: : I’ve...seen her before...
lines.zh: : 我……以前见过她……

lines.en: : Where? Like...a church or...something?
lines.zh: : 在哪儿？比如……教堂之类的？

lines.en: : She...
: Just...around...
lines.zh: : 就在……附近……

lines.en: scene yasufirstday21
I make my way over to the strange girl and quickly come to terms with exactly who she is.
lines.zh: 我朝那个奇怪的女孩走过去，很快就认清了她究竟是谁。

lines.en: And likely why no one wanted to talk to Makoto or me about her.
lines.zh: 大概也明白了，为什么没人愿意跟 Makoto 或我谈起她。

lines.en: : ...Yasu Yasui?
lines.zh: : ……Yasu Yasui？

lines.en: scene yasufirstday22
: Silly me. It appears I did have a name after all.
lines.zh: : 我真傻。看来我终究还是有个名字的。

lines.en: : Am I going to be punished for lying?
lines.zh: : 我会因为撒谎而受罚吗？

lines.en: : Do you think I am a sinner?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我是个罪人吗？

lines.en: : Do you like sinners?
lines.zh: : 你喜欢罪人吗？

lines.en: : How will you punish me, {i}Sensei?{/i}
lines.zh: : 你要怎么惩罚我呢，{i}Sensei？{/i}

lines.en: : See, Makoto? This is exactly why I didn’t know much about her. She’s straight up crazy.
lines.zh: : 看吧，Makoto？这就是为什么我对她了解不多。她根本就是个疯子。

lines.en: : You’re not really one to be calling people crazy, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 你可不是有资格说别人疯的人啊，Noriko。

lines.en: : Ahem! Silence, everyone.
lines.zh: : 咳咳！大家安静。

lines.en: : She may seem strange at first, but I’m sure she is perfectly normal.
lines.zh: : 她乍看之下也许有些奇怪，但我相信她完全正常。

lines.en: : Please let her introduce herself to everyone before passing judgement.
lines.zh: : 请先让她向大家做个自我介绍，再下判断也不迟。

lines.en: : Really? Askin’ to be fuckin’ punished within thirty seconds of showin’ up ain’t exactly {i}normal{/i}, four-eyes.
lines.zh: : 是吗？一露面三十秒就他妈求着被人惩罚，这可算不上{i}正常{/i}啊，四眼。

lines.en: : Yumi, if you’re going to act out, just leave.
lines.zh: : Yumi，你要是再闹，就出去。

lines.en: : Fuck that. I wanna see how this plays out.
lines.zh: : 去你的。我想看看这事怎么收场。

lines.en: : Ahh, so that one is Yumi. What a surprise.
lines.zh: : 啊，原来那个就是 Yumi。真是个惊喜。

lines.en: : If only Futaba were here today so I could show off.
lines.zh: : 要是 Futaba 今天在场就好了，我就能好好表现一下了。

lines.en: : Honestly, she’s kind of lucky she’s not. This girl’s givin’ me fucking chills.
lines.zh: : 说实话，她不在反倒是幸运。这姑娘看得我他妈直起鸡皮疙瘩。

lines.en: : So. Many. Voices.
lines.zh: : 好。多。的。声。音。

lines.en: : Can I have them?
lines.zh: : 我能拥有它们吗？

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what?
lines.zh: : 抱歉，你说什么？

lines.en: scene yasufirstday23
: How much can you see in the dark, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你在黑暗中能看见多少，Sensei？

lines.en: : I don’t understand-
lines.zh: : 我不明白——

lines.en: : How much can you see in the dark?
lines.zh: : 你在黑暗中能看见多少？

lines.en: : I really hope this is part of your introduction and not just how you’re going to be from now on.
lines.zh: : 我真希望这是你自我介绍的一部分，而不是你以后一贯的样子。

lines.en: : I can see everything there is to see in the dark.
lines.zh: : 黑暗中该看见的一切，我都能看见。

lines.en: : I have nightvision.
lines.zh: : 我有夜视能力。

lines.en: : And I come to you, in all of my glory, in all of my {b}PAIN{/b}-
lines.zh: : 而我带着我全部的荣光、全部的{b}痛苦{/b}，来到你们面前——

lines.en: : To guide these girls to salvation!
lines.zh: : 为的是引导这些女孩走向救赎！

lines.en: scene yasufirstday24
: TO GUIDE THEM TOWARD THE TRUTH!
lines.zh: : 引导她们走向真理！

lines.en: : Maya, want to weigh in on this?
lines.zh: : Maya，想说点什么吗？

lines.en: : ...Wait, are you talking to me?
lines.zh: : ……等等，你是在跟我说话？

lines.en: : Your name is Maya, isn't it?
lines.zh: : 你叫 Maya，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yes, but what would I possibly have to do with this crazy person?
lines.zh: : 是，不过我跟这个疯子能有什么关系？

lines.en: : I just assumed that since you’re the religious one, you’d have some sort of input on-
lines.zh: : 我只是觉得，既然你是信教的那个，你大概会有什么看法——

lines.en: : Oh, no. Don’t go calling me “the religious one” when I have made it incredibly apparent that I am only acting that way out of instinct and habit.
lines.zh: : 哦，不。别叫我是「信教的那个」，我已经说得非常清楚了，我只是出于本能和习惯才那样而已。

lines.en: : I am not touching this girl with a ten foot pole.
lines.zh: : 我就是拿十英尺长的杆子也不想碰这姑娘。

lines.en: : {i}Touch me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}来碰我啊。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Reach out and touch me.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}伸出手来碰我吧。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Reach toward the light and bathe in my flesh. My blood. For I shall carry you to the ends of the earth.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}向光伸出你的手，沐浴在我的血肉之中吧。因为我必将把你们带到世界的尽头。{/i}

lines.en: : Or, alternatively, you can sit down and just...stop with all of this weird gospel stuff.
lines.zh: : 或者，你也可以坐下来，别再搞这些奇怪的福音了。

lines.en: : Turn off the lights. Something wonderful is about to happen.
lines.zh: : 把灯关掉。美妙的事情即将发生。

lines.en: : The lights are staying-
lines.zh: : 灯是不会被——

lines.en: scene yasufirstday25
: How many bodies are in this room?
lines.zh: : 这间屋子里有多少具身体？

lines.en: : I’m sorry?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？

lines.en: : How many bodies? How many bodies? How many bodies? How many bodies? How many bodies? How many bodies? How many bodies?
lines.zh: : 多少具身体？多少具身体？多少具身体？多少具身体？多少具身体？多少具身体？多少具身体？

lines.en: : Even if you count, you will be wrong.
lines.zh: : 就算你数了，也会数错。

lines.en: : I see things you can not see. Hear things you can not hear. Why do you look away?
lines.zh: : 我能看见你们看不见的东西。听见你们听不见的声音。你为什么要移开视线？

lines.en: : I am looking directly at you.
lines.zh: : 我正直接看着你呢。

lines.en: : Are you, though?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？
: ……是真的吧？

scene 3

scene yasufirstday26
: I am Yasu Yasui! Messenger of the one so commonly mislabeled!
lines.zh: : 我是 Yasu Yasui！是那位常被误解者的使者！

lines.en: : The one so commonly overlooked! With compassion mistaken for callousness!
lines.zh: : 是那位常被忽视者的使者！他的慈悲被误认成了冷漠！

lines.en: : Yes! Another one of my people! Finally!
lines.zh: : 太好了！我的同类又多了一个！终于！

lines.en: : She appears to be less approachable than you, Emerald Guard-
lines.zh: : 她看起来比您还难以接近呢，翡翠卫队——

lines.en: : Shh! I want to hear her speech!
lines.zh: : 嘘！我要听她讲话！

lines.en: : Years and years and years and years and years ago, there was a light.
lines.zh: : 很久很久很久很久很久以前，有一道光。

lines.en: : That light gave birth to all things.
lines.zh: : 那道光孕育了万物。

lines.en: : You, me, the ground, the sky, the animals, the air, the water-
lines.zh: : 你、我、大地、天空、动物、空气、水——

lines.en: : It all comes from the light.
lines.zh: : 一切都源自那道光。

lines.en: : And it comes in a form safer than the sun. A form that you can stare into for prolonged periods of time and not return blind-
lines.zh: : 它的形态比太阳更安全。一种你可以长久凝视、却不会失明着归来的形态——

lines.en: : But return with vision unparalleled. Unmatched.
lines.zh: : 归来时带着无可比拟、无与伦比的视力。

lines.en: : You return with the ability to see everything!
lines.zh: : 你归来时便拥有看见一切的能力！

lines.en: : How many of you will believe, knowing all of these things are possible?!
lines.zh: : 既然知道这一切皆有可能，你们当中有多少人愿意相信？！

lines.en: : How many of you will come with me?!
lines.zh: : 你们当中有多少人愿意跟我走？！

lines.en: scene yasufirstday27
: None of you?
lines.zh: : 一个都没有吗？

lines.en: : How very sad.
lines.zh: : 真是可悲。

lines.en: : I offer you a chance to see everything...and yet you sit behind those strange wooden blocks, finicking with loose strings on your uniforms and turning away from a messenger of God.
lines.zh: : 我给了你们一个看见一切的机会……而你们却坐在那些奇怪的木块后面，拨弄着制服上松脱的线头，背转过身去，不愿面对一位上帝的使者。

lines.en: : I wonder how many of you can truly be saved.
lines.zh: : 我很好奇，你们当中有多少人真的能被拯救。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday28
: I WONDER HOW MANY OF YOU CAN TRULY BE SAVED!
lines.zh: : 我！很！好！奇！你们当中有多少人真能被拯救！

lines.en: scene yasufirstday29
: Hello, everyone. My name is Yasu Yasui, and I will be a student in this class starting today.
lines.zh: : 大家好。我叫 Yasu Yasui，从今天起就是这班上的学生了。

lines.en: : I’m rather shy when it comes to meeting new people, so I hope you will all be gentle with me.
lines.zh: : 我在见生人这方面比较害羞，所以希望大家都对我温柔一点。

lines.en: : My hobbies include reading and seeing how long I can hold my breath underwater until the world starts to go fuzzy.
lines.zh: : 我的爱好是读书，还有在水下憋气，看能撑到多久、直到世界变得模糊。

lines.en: : The longest I have lasted is three whole minutes.
lines.zh: : 我最长的记录是整整三分钟。

lines.en: : I have never [masturbate]d before and love the sound of cicadas more than anything else I’ve ever heard.
lines.zh: : 我从来没有[masturbate]过，而且比起我听过的任何声音，我都更爱蝉鸣。

lines.en: : Woah, wait. What? Who just drops that kind of info into an introduction?
lines.zh: : 哇，等等。什么？谁会在自我介绍里突然丢出这种信息啊？

lines.en: : A crazy person, Kirin.
lines.zh: : 疯子啊，Kirin。

lines.en: : But hey, on the bright side, my intro is no longer the weirdest!
lines.zh: : 不过话说回来，往好处想，我的自我介绍不再是最怪的那个了！

lines.en: : Thanks, creepy ghost girl!
lines.zh: : 谢了，阴森森的幽灵妹！

lines.en: scene yasufirstday30
Yasu makes her way over to Touka’s desk and gently places her hands on it, lowering both her body and the volume of her voice as if to say “I’m harmless.”
lines.zh: Yasu 走到 Touka 的课桌旁，轻轻把手放在桌上，压低了身子和音量，仿佛在说「我没有恶意」。

lines.en: It’s almost like she’s attempting to confirm what she told me the other night about how she has no reason to hurt anyone.
lines.zh: 这几乎就像是在印证她那晚跟我说过的话——她没有任何理由去伤害任何人。

lines.en: But judging by Sana, who’s still holding her tears back in the corner of the room despite not even being acknowledged by Yasu, this clearly isn’t true.
lines.zh: 但看看 Sana 就知道了——尽管 Yasu 根本没理会她，她仍在教室角落里强忍着眼泪——这显然不是事实。

lines.en: There are more ways to hurt people than just damaging their outer shells.
lines.zh: 伤害人的方式不止破坏外壳这一种。

lines.en: Sometimes, the most painful experiences are the ones that start from within, rupturing our organs or, in many cases, the wires we use to transfer our thoughts.
lines.zh: 有时候，最痛苦的经历是从内部开始的：它撕裂我们的器官，或者更多时候，撕裂我们用来传递思绪的那些线。

lines.en: Once those wires fray, our thoughts run rampant and infect everything else both inside of and around us.
lines.zh: 一旦那些线磨损，我们的思绪就会失控蔓延，感染我们体内和周围的一切。

lines.en: I watch as my two newest students infect each other.
lines.zh: 我眼看着自己两个最新的学生互相感染。

lines.en: : Excuse me...You are Touka Tsukioka, correct?
lines.zh: : 打扰一下……你是 Touka Tsukioka，对吧？

lines.en: : No. That’s somebody else. Goodbye.
lines.zh: : 不是。那是别人。再见。

lines.en: : So much for your name being important to you.
lines.zh: : 你不是说自己的名字很重要吗。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday31
: Silence! Can’t you see that my life is in danger right now?! Call my mother immediately!
lines.zh: : 闭嘴！你没看见我现在有生命危险吗？！马上给我母亲打电话！

lines.en: : You’re in no danger at all. I’m so frail and pitiful that a girl like you would be able to snap me like a twig if she so wanted.
lines.zh: : 你一点危险都没有。我又虚弱又可怜，像你这样的姑娘只要想，就能像折树枝一样把我折断。

lines.en: : Please don’t hurt me, Touka. I beg for your forgiveness.
lines.zh: : 请不要伤害我，Touka。我乞求你的原谅。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday32
: I...um...okay?
lines.zh: : 我……呃……好吧？

lines.en: : Will...will that be all?
lines.zh: : 就……就这样了吗？

lines.en: : Of course. I won’t disturb you any more than I already have.
lines.zh: : 当然。我不会再比现在更多地打扰你了。

lines.en: : My introduction seemed to veer a bit off the tracks. But, you see, that’s not my fault.
lines.zh: : 我的自我介绍似乎有点跑偏了。不过你看，那不是我的错。

lines.en: : I hear things sometimes. I hear things that make me {i}do{/i} things.
lines.zh: : 我有时会听见一些声音。听见一些会驱使我去{i}做{/i}事的声音。

lines.en: : But I will never do anything to you. I promise.
lines.zh: : 但我绝不会对你做任何事。我保证。

lines.en: : Thank...you?...
: You’re welcome.
lines.zh: : 不客气。

lines.en: : Oh...And I’ll also be moving into your dorm room after class today.
lines.zh: : 哦……还有，今天下课后我就要搬进你的宿舍房间了。

lines.en: : But I won’t take long. I don’t have very many things.
lines.zh: : 不过我不会占用太久。我的东西不多。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday33
: You’re...moving into...{i}my{/i} room?
lines.zh: : 你要……搬进……{i}我的{/i}房间？

lines.en: : Are you sure you don’t want to trade with anyone else?
lines.zh: : 你确定不想跟别人换换吗？

lines.en: scene yasufirstday34
: Would anyone else like to live with me?
lines.zh: : 还有别人愿意跟我住吗？

lines.en: : I promise to not be any sort of hindrance to your daily lives.
lines.zh: : 我保证不会给你们日常生活添任何麻烦。

lines.en: : D-Don’t all jump at once! I understand how exciting this opportunity must be and-
lines.zh: : 别——别一下子全都扑上来啊！我明白这个机会有多令人激动，而且——

lines.en: scene yasufirstday35
: It doesn’t appear that anyone else wants to live with me...
lines.zh: : 看来没有别人愿意跟我住了……

lines.en: : Please, Touka?...Will you be my friend?
lines.zh: : 求你了，Touka？……你愿意做我的朋友吗？

lines.en: : I promise I’ll be a good girl...
lines.zh: : 我保证会做个乖女孩……

lines.en: : Don’t you...have anywhere else to stay?
lines.zh: : 你……没有别的地方可以住吗？

lines.en: : We can’t all be as rich and precious as you, Touka.
lines.zh: : 我们不可能都像你一样又富有又金贵啊，Touka。

lines.en: : For me, the only choices are the dorm room, a dark alley somewhere cold, or the sanctuary.
lines.zh: : 对我来说，只有三个选择：宿舍房间、某处阴冷的小巷，或者圣所。

lines.en: : I have a weak constitution, so the alley will likely kill me. And sleeping too often in the sanctuary will kill me even faster.
lines.zh: : 我体质很弱，所以小巷多半会要了我的命。而在圣所里睡得太勤，会死得更快。
: 我……明白了……

lines.en: : Well...I would certainly not want you to get hurt, but...
lines.zh: : 嗯……我当然不想看你受伤，不过……

lines.en: : I...I am also not very exciting to be around and...we appear to be extremely different.
lines.zh: : 我……我也不是个有趣的人，而且……我们看起来差别非常大。

lines.en: scene yasufirstday36
: Back to the alley it is, then...
lines.zh: : 那就回小巷去吧……

lines.en: : I’m very sorry for bothering you...
lines.zh: : 非常抱歉打扰你了……

lines.en: : Wait! No! It’s...
lines.zh: : 等等！不！那是……

lines.en: : Fine! You can stay in my room with me!
lines.zh: : 好吧！你可以跟我一起住我的房间！

lines.en: : But...only until you find somewhere else!
lines.zh: : 不过……只到你找到别的地方为止！

lines.en: scene yasufirstday37
: A slumber party! I’m so excited!
lines.zh: : 睡衣派对！我好兴奋！

lines.en: : We’ll be like normal girls for once in our lives.
lines.zh: : 我们这辈子总算能像普通女孩一样了。

lines.en: : Okay...
lines.zh: : 好吧……

lines.en: scene black
Yasu doesn’t sit down following the conversation with Touka.
lines.zh: 和 Touka 谈完之后，Yasu 并没有坐下。

lines.en: She proceeds to stand in the corner of the room for five minutes, though. So that’s a thing that happens.
lines.zh: 不过她接着在教室角落里站了五分钟。所以这种事就这么发生了。

lines.en: After that, she exits the classroom without saying another word.
lines.zh: 之后，她一句话没再说就走出了教室。

lines.en: It takes Sana a full hour to calm down. And, even after she does, it’s clear that she remains at least mildly on edge until the end of the[school] day.
lines.zh: Sana 花了整整一个小时才平静下来。而且就算平静了，很明显她在[school]这一天结束前都始终有些紧绷。

lines.en: The bell rings and everyone goes back to living their lives the way they normally would.
lines.zh: 铃响了，每个人都回去过他们平常的日子。

lines.en: Well, everyone except Touka- who now not only has to figure out a way to survive amidst a flurry of commoners, but deal with a girl who the rest of us have no idea how to approach.
lines.zh: 好吧，除了 Touka——她现在不光得想办法在一群平民中间活下来，还得应付一个我们所有人都不知道该怎么接近的女孩。

lines.en: I wish her the best.
lines.zh: 祝她好运吧。
